reviews.text: Amazing experience as always, this Vet Hosp goes above and beyond to take care of your precious pets, my 3 pups had dental cleanings. Thank you to Dr Pitt and Dr. Choy and the amazing techs that work in the back!! Last but not least thank you to the Evelyn & the ladies at the front desk you work so hard and deal with so many clients. I have to really hand it to you. I don’t know how you do it.

I’m very thankful to Dr. Pitt and the caring techs such as Joshua who took care of our kitties after they caught a respiratory virus at another vet I had taken them to for their booster Vaccines, in Gardena. Dr. Pitt properly Diagnosed our kittens and gave them the proper meds they needed. As of today, they are on their own and God willing they are on the road to recovery. We are very thankful to Mid Valley Veterinarians and techs! Even your receptionists are very nice! Thank you to you all 🙌🏼🙏🏼🫶🏻

I rescued another dog from someone struggling financially etc.  I set up an appointment somewhere but the wait was too far into the future.  She was not spayed, no vaccines, nails needed cutting and no microchip, obviously no Wellness ever done.  I have a regular vet but decided to go back to the one my Husband and I used in the past plus it was closer to home, so I called Mid Valley Vet and they had many immediate options.  I took her in the next morning at 9am (Sat).  Jayline was wonderful. Patient, helpful and the Vet believe his name was Timmons was good.  We have seen Dr. Pitt in the past.  The doctor had a calm bedside manner.  The good news is they were able to do everything needed today!  Spay, microchip, shots, nails cut.  She had only eaten a handful of dry food this morning so I was concerned but her surgery was approved and was I ever Thankful to have everything done at one time!  The Center was pretty clean and the outside was cleaner than usual.  The prices are fair as my Vet in Burbank is double the price but she is quite exceptional!!!  Thank you Mid Valley Vet Care.  The office just called and I can pick her up by 3:30pm today.

After 10 years of ALWAYS taking my 2 dogs as well as 3 of my friends dogs from time to time, I just had enough. The last year and a half have been ridiculous with their prices. They have increased their regular prices but then added so many non-sense charges where their bills have more than trippled.
To top it off, their vets are the most rudest ones I have seen. They do not even know how to talk to a person.

I took my 12yr chiweenie here because of her heart condition and I was relieved with the service and care they provided they work with you if your on a budget with the payment plan “cherry” and it takes a lot off your shoulders when it comes to the expenses for our little furry family am grateful they were able to help my best friend.. this clinic has officially become our dogs to go clinic spot highly recommend it now I’m relieved my dog can sleep well without any heart problems bothering her or threatening her life.

Front desk personnel are pretty rude —inept at customer service and professionalism. Also, even with an appointment, be prepared to wait a ridiculous amount of time—without even a reason why, an apology, or any acknowledgment from the front desk staff that they are aware you and your pet exist.

Front desk staff literally just sit and talk, laugh, eat and ignore. They are not on top of anything up front. I have been there at least 10 different times with my 2 dogs. Same experience every time.

Dr. Pitt is an excellent, knowledgeable, intelligent, empathetic doctor. He literally is the best there is. Dr. Pitt also doesn’t try to just charge anything to make some huge profit. Your pet will honestly be better off from his work and expertise!

Staff techs are wonderful, very experienced, knowledgeable, and personable too!

Im surprised the reviews aren't because we have a fantastic experience today with our boy Muncie. We were seen 15min after our apt and Dr Pitts was kind and caring. Muncie had a laceration and his ear and we were taken care of within 2 hours of closing. Muncie had to be sedated to get stitches and all was done in a fast time, even with a busy waiting room.

I highly recommend this vet and well be back for any other needs.
If you go here, *only* see Dr.Michael Pitt, not anyone else. There is another vet here who is super old and maybe almost deaf. He cannot diagnose properly or communicate properly.

Alex the manager was very caring and kind to me and my cat giggi when he ended up with kidney stones bc I overfed my cat dry food for years. Alex was compassionate and understanding of my financial situation fixed income and he was willing to find a surgery price that was affordable to me. I would highly recommend this veterinary hospital im emergency situations such as the condition I brought my cat gigi in. They have saved his life. He would die without kidney stone surgery.
Always over booked any simple appointments. Plan spending an hr or so waiting! Or plan B go somewhere else. Place smells horrible and it’s dirty all the time. I’m done coming here.

Huge thank you to @midvalleyvet_vannuys for taking such great care of Kiwi. ❤️ They saw her through her pregnancy, and when it was time to get her spayed, they made it possible with pricing that didn’t break the bank. We all know how expensive veterinary procedures can be, so we truly appreciated their kindness and transparency.

If you’re looking for an honest, affordable vet, ask for Alex. Thank you again for taking such great care of our girl! 🐾💕
Dr. Pitt is amazing- highly recommend him and his services. He's been taking care of our pets for the last 20 years

Please do not bring your dogs here. Worst vet ever. Failed to diagnose my dog with a huge splenic tumor which ended up being fatal and cancerous. Every problem we ever had we had to fight for a diagnosis and treatment. The staff in the office is always very rude and unhelpful. We were never called back during emergencies or received records in a timely manner. Every time we had blood drawn on our dog they “lost the sample” or never sent it in but did not notify us. When we called to ask for results after weeks, they said they had lost the sample and we would have to come back in to get the blood drawn again. But again, they never called us to let us know there was a problem and this happened over and over again. Even if you have a scheduled appointment you always end up waiting at least 2 hours or even more. Most of the time we ended up going back home because it’s not fair to make our dog wait in the car for 2 hours. When trying to get my dogs records to transfer to a different vet I was hung up on by the front office.
Awesome

Brought our beloved dog . Was drinking, walking  and vomiting. They suggested a surgery due to a partial occlusion of his intestines. after stabilizing him with an ivy a barium study for ourbeloved dog, stabilized out dog for 2 hours for iv and antibiotics . Our dog was walked in at close 12 pm , attended and had IVY at 1 pm for overnight monitoring  then surgery if our dog doesn’t poop. They make you pay 75% outright which tgey calculated 3t plus or more. We paid $2,200 for his overnight stay as partial payment and if he doesn’t poop in 24 hours they will do surgery after barium administration . At 3pm they said they are still monitoring our dog. My daughter calls at past 5pm of the same day and the doctor just  decided to do the surgery the same day with out consent, without barium study. They called before 6pm and our beloved dog is dead due to cardiac arrest. I asked to see the doctor 2x to explain what happened. But he is busy. IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET DO NOT BRING TO THIS HOSPITAL. I am asking the technician what happend to the plan pf the barium study before surgery. No answers just pt was critical if deemed so critical they could have called us and informed us of his cobdition. We brought our dog to be treated and cared for NEGLIGENCE is not what we need.

I made an appointment over the phone at 6:15. Didn’t get a call until 745. The reception is in the middle Doesn’t give the right information made me waste a whole hour when I had an emergency even though I told her over the phone that it was an emergency. I don’t think she knows what her job is.

I took my cat to this vet for his yearly vaccines (if you go on a Tuesday or Saturday in the evening they have each vaccine for $25) and they did so well with my feisty cat. He was a little stressed when he was returned to me and the vet techs were nice enough to take him in for observation for him to calm down. I have taken my dog here before and they were all great with her.

I wish I could rate Zero stars. My dog had a terrible disease. The Doctor never called me back after several attempts to contact him. I had to put my dog to sleep after 14 years! Absolutely the worst thing that could happen to our lives. I do not want to say more as I don't want to mix anger with sorrow. Poor Haven is in Heaven.

This place is absolutely terrible and extremely unprofessional. Dr. Pitt showed zero compassion or care for my dog and was incredibly rude. The staff made the entire experience even worse with their dismissive and disrespectful attitude. All they seem to care about is taking your money, not actually helping your pet. There was no follow-up, no concern, and no accountability. I left feeling frustrated, upset, and taken advantage of. If you truly care about your dog, stay far away from this place.

Extremely unprofessional.
My dog had a serious condition, a test was taken, and I was told the results would be ready in one week. After multiple follow-ups, no one ever called back.
Instead of providing the results, they asked me to book another appointment just to hear them. Complete lack of responsibility and urgency. Would not recommend.

Very disappointing experience with Dr. Michael Pitt.
A test was taken for my dog with a clear promise that results would be ready within one week. This was a serious and potentially dangerous issue.
Despite multiple follow-ups, no one ever called back. After over a week, I was told I had to book another appointment just to be told the results, which is completely unprofessional.
Because of the lack of urgency and responsibility, my dog’s condition worsened. I will not be returning and do not recommend this clinic

Don’t recommend this place at all. I tried calling because my dog needs medical attention and didn’t know what to do on how I should transport him there and they just answer the phone in a very hostile way and very angry. They tell me they’ll call me back and never do! Very unprofessional and very rude young lady at the desk taking calls! Save yourself the headache and avoid this place

This office and all of their staff saved my foster puppy! Unfortunately her sister had to be put down but they hospitalized this puppy who is now named “Whitney” for 10 days and she survived parvo. The staff was very sweet and caring I was crying nonstop for hours and they comforted me and gave me condolences. After helping me get CareCredit and even discounting so I can properly put down her sister, they answered every call and every question I had within those 10 days she was hospitalized. They showed me human kindness and compassion still exist!!! ❤️💙

I am writing to express my profound disappointment with the veterinary services I recently received at Mid Valley Veterinary Hospital. As a pet owner, entrusting the health and well-being of my dog to a veterinary professional is a decision I take seriously. Unfortunately, my experience with this clinic was far below the standards of care and professionalism I expect.

From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was unwelcoming. The front desk staff 1 being Jennifer & another young lady seemed disengaged and disinterested in providing assistance. When I interacted with one of the employees, her demeanor was shockingly rude and hostile. Her behavior was not only unprofessional but also deeply unsettling, creating an environment of discomfort and distrust.

Beyond the poor customer service, I am concerned about the overall quality of care provided. The lack of empathy and respect displayed by the staff raises questions about their commitment to the well-being of the animals under their care. As a result, I cannot recommend this veterinary practice to other pet owners. The combination of unprofessional conduct and poor customer service makes it an unsuitable choice for anyone seeking compassionate and competent veterinary care. I will not be returning to this clinic and advise others to consider alternative options.

Always double check that they dispense the right meds and shots.
Several times they've neglected to fill one of the Rxs, as we had discussed. Several times they've asked me "What kind of eye drops?" (Hello, is it not written in the chart? Aren't you guys the professionals?) Once they gave me another type of drops and said "we're out of the other one."
Once they gave her an allergy shot which was very effective. 😀 Months later I requested another allergy shot, but for some reason it was totally ineffective. When I inquired about it, they checked and said the second shot was a different. So I was out the $$ for the useless shot because they didn't bother to check which medication they had given before. 😠 I requested a repeat of the first allergy shot, but they did not provide it at their own expense.
You probably need to keep track of the  medications they're giving your animal, and remind them to give you that.
They do keep track of the scheduled rabies, distemper, Bordetella shots and send you reminders. 🙂
Bottom line is they frequently run out of medications which they prescribe, leaving you with the task of 1) trying to find it at a brick and mortar store (<--good luck!), or 2) ordering online. They don't offer a substitute or home remedy which you might have on hand. I might as well have tried to treat the animal myself since I have to wait at least five days to get two important medications.  Why are they so unprepared? 😳
They now charge $95 for walk-ins.
Because they're open decent hours and they don't keep you waiting an inordinate amount of time like other offices, I'm giving them four stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐

Expensive for my pocket, but average for all veterinary clinics, I if I have to bring my pet to a veterinary it will be here, specialty if Dr Michael D Pitt. Is the one checking my pet. He does have a heart.

We brought her to another clinic -Van Nuys veterinary clinic- and doctor a couple of months ago (he was Chinese) and the care she received with Dr Michael was a whole lot special. The othere clinics Dr didn't even want to touch her to examine her, didn't want to even answer all the questions we had.

Todays we did get the best care we could get for the time we were in the office. Thank you Dr Pitt.

I just can’t explain the love that I’m so thankful of still exists in this world. I currently don’t have money for Christmas or for my dogs recovery surgery. My sister Kionna aka Kiki Savior and Dr. Pitts who made sure my pet/only son lived is more l than I  want for this Christmas or ANY DAY. This is not the first time Dr. Pitts has come through in the clutch. He really has a good heart and spirit, this is my line of work, I can assure that  he does for REAL. Dr. Pitts doesn’t want it , but I have to put him on the list with my sister of those whom deserve so much more than they have given with a pure heart , expecting nothing in return or at least not all they have given. My dog is my best friend and son, and he loves more than humans , truth. I really can’t repay Dr. Pitts, but I will try to come as close as possible when I get the opportunity. Forever eternally grateful to encounter true love and expertise in Dr. Pitts. 💯💯💯💯🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿❤️❤️❤️. I pray he receives all that he has given out 100 fold back to him or his loved ones. He has blessed me before , I KNOW this is Truly who he is. ❤️

After subsequent visits, I have to raise my review to five stars. I saw that Dr. Pitt really loves animals. He and the staff went above and beyond for me and my cat.  This has been my permanent vet for years.

I don't know the doctors name, but we have had bad experiences with him. Older guy with glasses. Two times I took my dogs to the vet and they saw him and he told me that one of them needed surgery to get her teeth pulled when she just had bad allergies that day. We wanted a second opinion and was then treated for allergies which she got better from. The second time we saw him, we thought my other dog had a stroke, but it was vestibular syndrome. He wouldn't eat anything. The doctor told us he might need to stay overnight at the hospital which we didn't agree on. Then.. charged us for that. He also told us my dog had a "bad heart" but he didn't elaborate on it and proceeded to charge us for heart medicine. We asked another doctor at another vet and he said the only thing you can hear heart wise are murmurs. He might have meant my dog had a strong heart murmur, but we weren't sure because it came up out of nowhere...? If he had a bad heart murmur, he would have had trouble exercising!! but he is a very energetic and active So I am assuming he was going to charge us for pointless medicine for a small (non life threatening) murmur? That doesn't make any sense... Plus what would have the medicine be for?? It can't cure a murmur.  We were charged about $4,000 in total which obviously we had to take things off.. That doctor, He wasn't thorough, he wasn't compassionate, I believe he may be in it for the money. The nurses don't know much if you ask them because they just say "well let me ask the doctor". I don't feel this place is very good when you need a thorough opinion and a good checkup. Their wait times are very short probably because they rush everyone out and don't want to give patients their time. I don't know about the other doctors, they might be good, but if you ever get this one, don't go with him unless you want a speedy non-thorough DISHONEST checkup and want to get charged your whole life savings for stuff your dog doesn't need. Keep in mind, my dog with vestibular syndrome recovered while being at home. Do your own research and don't give this specific doctor your time.

I am extremely disappointed with this clinic. I only came here because I was referred for the surgery my dog needed, but the experience has been nothing but frustrating!  The wait times are outrageously long, even when the lobby is nearly empty. There never seems to be enough staff. They don’t take appointments for post surgery check ups, so you’re forced into a walk-in system that leaves you waiting for hours with no updates. On top of that, the front office staff is consistently rude and unhelpful, a basic question is an inconvenience.

For the clinic’s sake and its clients, I strongly recommend implementing an appointment system or at least offering scheduled time blocks to cut down on the excessive wait times. Better staffing and more communication with clients would make a huge difference.

I won’t be returning after I am done with all the post op visits, and I definitely wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone who values their time or their pet’s well-being.

I’ve been taking my foster dog to this clinic for about 10 months for a chronic skin condition and have always paid out of pocket since the rescue didn’t think treatment was necessary. I never had any issues until recently, when my foster dog needed an unexpected surgery that cost over $1,400. The rescue didn’t have the funds available but offered to cover a small portion (10%) if the dog was registered under their account.

When I tried to register the dog under the rescue to apply that discount, the front office gave me a very difficult time and even refused to let me pay with my own credit card — even though the rescue was going to reimburse me in payments. Instead of showing understanding, they accused me of only wanting the discount, which was extremely insulting considering I’ve been paying full price for nearly a year.

After things got heated, they decided to deactivate my account completely, which is very disappointing. I’ve never had an issue with the doctor directly — the doctors here are caring and professional — but the real problem has always been the front desk staff. They’re consistently rude, overbook the doctors, and even with a scheduled appointment the wait can be up to two hours.

I’ve been bringing different dogs and cats here for over 12 years, and not one receptionist has lasted long. It seems they keep hiring rude and untrained employees with no manners or respect for the fact that our pets are family members. The front office staff clearly doesn’t care about your pet — they just want to get you in and out as quickly as possible, without answering questions or taking the time to make clients feel heard.

It’s truly disappointing to see how poor customer service can ruin what could otherwise be a great veterinary practice.
Good service, reasonable prices

Worse service ever! Do NOT take your pet here!!! The ladies in the front are rude. You can’t ask to many questions because they’ll give you attitude as if you have no right to ask questions about YOUR OWN PET… I went in for my dogs final vaccination’s,  there was a misunderstanding in how many more rounds of shots my dog needed. I asked the lady who was helping me, and she said “oh his chart is with my manager”. I asked okay where is the manger? She responded with “Oh she isn’t here”. OKAY so where is my pet’s file, why does she have it, and why isn’t the file in the proper place?!?! She obviously was annoyed I was asking questions. If you can’t handle customer service as a front desk receptionist, DO NOT WORK IN THAT FEILD. And now I got notice I can’t ever go back to their office for my per.  Soooo if you go here be sure to not ask too many questions or you’ll get banned.. I should have known not to go back, because about a year ago I took my dog who was very ill. Even the vet noticed my pet’s vomit smelled horrible, that’s the first thing he mentioned coming into the room “oh that’s a very bad smell”. They took X-rays of her and said she needed surgery the next morning, I agreed and said ok. I agreed, I left at 3pm, and returned back around 4 because my dog had passed away!! Worse heartbreak ever. Trusted them, and they obviously only did the minimum care for my pet. They don’t care about your pets. If you REALLY LOVE YOUR PET - DO NOT COME HERE!!! They just want to get you the heck out of their office as quick as possible!
The Best Veterinary Dr. in San Fernando Valley!

BEWARE! DO NOT take your fur baby’s here! Dr. Pitt makes excuse after inexcusable lame excuse! I’ve been a client for years and they have completely DECLINED the past couple years! They NEVER call with test results, have you do “emergency” EXPENSIVE testing and NEVER give results and MISDIAGNOSE!! I’m DISGUSTED that they are in business and reporting to the Veterinary's Association for CA. My 2 dogs have suffered at the hands of this mismanaged medical care and dangerous office practice’s!

Terrible Experience — Misdiagnosis and Overcharging Attempt

I brought my cat to this clinic for urgent care because they said he might have pyometra — a serious and potentially fatal infection of the uterus. After doing blood work, X-rays, and a physical exam, they told me it would cost $2,700 for surgery and hospitalization.

What’s shocking is that my cat is a male, and pyometra only occurs in female cats. Despite all the tests and examinations, the vet failed to notice this very basic fact. This kind of mistake is not only careless but could have cost my cat his life if I had agreed to unnecessary treatment.

I left feeling completely betrayed and heartbroken. I paid for testing that was based on a misdiagnosis, and not once did anyone take responsibility for such a fundamental error. Pet owners trust veterinarians to be competent and thorough — especially when serious conditions and high costs are involved.

Please be cautious if you come here. Always ask for a second opinion before agreeing to expensive procedures.

SAVE YOUR TIME! This place sucks. I had an 11:00 appointment. I checked in and due to their very small waiting room and having a large adult dog I told them I would wait in the car and to call me when it was time to bring my dog in. Sat in my car for an hour while I ran the a/c to keep my dog cool. I left and scheduled an appointment with another vet. As I write this review I have yet to receive a call from this place. As I was finishing this review they just called me...AN HOUR AND A HALF LATER THAN MY APPOINTMENT!!!!

Mid valley they kill my cat.
They are very irresponsible i don't recommend the clinic.
This place is horrible! I would not recommend going here. The doctor here is so rude and mean, along with the girls working the front desk! 😖😡 …

Mid Valley Veterinarian is completely unprofessional and not worth your time or money. I went in back in April for a simple grooming clearance note. I did agree to vaccines — but I could have gone elsewhere for that. I chose to stay and paid almost  $300 because I was assured I would receive the note I needed. It’s now July, and I still don’t have it. I called repeatedly and was constantly told, “We’ll leave a note” or “We’ll pass along the message.” Clearly, they didn’t. When I showed up in person, the staff looked at me like they had no idea what I was talking about. I was tired of them so I demanded their medical records and they refused to give me my dog’s medical records. Again, they said they’d follow up, and again — nothing. The only person who was honest and helpful was Rosalie or Rosalyn. She admitted that no one ever passed along my messages and that there was nothing noted in the system. After months of calling and showing up, she was the first person to tell me the truth. I finally got the records — but still no clearance note, which is the only reason I came in to begin with. Jessica, the manager, was supposedly the only one who could help, but she was never available. She either rarely shows up or avoids dealing with problems altogether.Also, this is the only clinic my dog has ever been to. So who else did they expect would write the clearance note? Their lack of logic and responsibility is beyond frustrating. Dr. Pitt was respectful and professional, but it doesn’t matter how good he is when the staff around him is this careless and disorganized.They wasted my time, took my money, and failed to provide a basic service. I would never come back — and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Mid-Valley Veterinary Hospital — Dr. Jose Choy is THAT guy.

I brought my two sons, well, technically they’re dogs but don’t tell them that, Rocky and Brooklyn to Mid-Valley after Rocky started having an unfortunate gastrointestinal adventure (read: diarrhea and vomiting). And like true brothers, Brooklyn decided to join the party a day later. I’m guessing they shared more than just water. Thanks, boys.

Our usual spot, Modern Animal, was booked solid, so they recommended Mid-Valley. And let me just say, what a blessing in disguise. From the moment we walked in, the whole staff was warm, welcoming, and totally on it. No cold stares or rushed vibes. Just genuinely good people who actually seemed happy to be helping.

Enter Dr. Jose Choy. Calm, practical, no nonsense. He didn’t try to upsell me into a second mortgage worth of labs and meds. Instead, he assessed the situation, made solid recommendations, and explained everything clearly. A rare combo of competent and compassionate.

Fast forward a few days, and my boys are back to their zoomie-loving, tail-wagging selves. I honestly couldn’t be more grateful. Dr. Choy and his team treated us like family, the kind that actually likes you.

Mid-Valley has officially earned a spot in our emergency contacts. Thanks again, Dr. Choy and crew. You all are fantastic.

Took my cat here and they ran tests kept him for 2 days sent him home and said he was fine after spending 3k, he was OK for a few weeks then he started having the same symptoms they again asked to keep him for a few days which cost another 3k .... at the end of it all my cat ended up passing away all the test they did were worthless because my cat had Giardia and the test they did they couldn't figure it out ..... I will never take any of my pets here ever again .... this place is a rip off and they do not care about your pet please do not go here
The best! All our kitties get their care here. And the strays in our neighborhood who need medical attention, too. Caring, wonderful staff. Highly recommend.

I don't know where to begin. My boyfriend brought his dog here on Sunday, June 4, 2025, for knee surgery. They released him at 6 p.m. that same day, and we took him home. He followed all of Dr. Pitt's instructions. The next day, my boyfriend noticed something wasn't right with his dog and brought him back to the clinic. At noon, they told him everything was fine, but by 5 p.m., his dog was dead. No one could say what happened. No one has called my boyfriend to give him an explanation, not even the doctor to offer him any comfort. I think this place doesn't value the lives of animals. For my boyfriend, he wasn't just another pet; he was his everything, his dog. My boyfriend is completely devastated; he has no consolation. Everyone in the family is in shock; we still can't believe it. The dog was a healthy dog; he didn't have any other problems, just his knee. We are very sad and hope someone will give my boyfriend an explanation. You don't know how devastated he is; it's an irreparable loss.

What stupid people this hospital has. Please, gentlemen, do not bring your dog here because just because the internet doesn't work, they take you out of the system and they don't want to give your dog medicine or something.
Dr. Pitt is amazing!
Everyone is great there and reasonably priced.
DR. PITT is the best! Very knowledgeable and the staff along with the other doctors took great care of BELLA. I would highly recommend. Thank you Mid Valley Veterinary Hospital

They helped me say goodbye to my 16 year old fur lady, Ruby. All of the staff were very kind, caring, and understanding. The doctor had such kind words for her after he examined her and after administering the final medication. Thank you to all of you for your help.

The worst customer care. They destroyed me financially,  emotionally. Young 20 something yr olds running the place. I was not allowed to speak with owner regarding huge mistake these kids made. All my attempts feudal! Unconsionable that the owner would not speak with me , and put it in hands of pure incompetency.  My dog had to suffer , and I had to suffer financially bc of this place. If you want caring , decent , honest veterinary care this is NOT the place ! He makes so much money , that 1 person's beloved dog doesn't matter! There are some great veterinary clinics out there. This is def NOT one of them !

Very caring vets ive taken all my cats there ..I lost my cat this weekend and they were very understanding and compassionate for my lovely cat. I knew she was in good hands. And made her feel comfortable on her last day. Thank you ❤️‍🩹 …
I have been waiting 2 days for a call back from doctor for the results of my pets urine test...I have left 5 messages. It would probably take just a 5 min call. Iam getting pissed.
DONT BRING YOUR FUR BABIES HERE !!! Worst place ever they just want your money and could care less if your babies are fine
Hate it hereee
don’t go here. They keep animals overnight to make them more sick for money. Stay away!

After Mochi’s overnight, they told me his fever was gone, he’s eating, acting normal, etc. And they only suggested to keep him one more night just so the fever doesn’t relapse, BUT it’d be up to me and that he doesn’t need to. Plus they sent me home with antibiotics. When I visited him he seemed traumatized and out of it, and the vet tech kept assuring me he just went through a lot and is anxious. Did not recommend me to keep him after that point.

So I decided to take him home with antibiotics and he’s never sprayed out of anxiousness but did in his carrier and just seemed super out of it. Right when he got home he was breathing super heavy and had a respiratory rate of 92, normally should be 20-30. Luckily no fever, but he is still extremely lethargic and there is no sedative in him to even contribute to this. When I called back the facility, they started to IMMEDIATELY point fingers and say that they suggested I kept him overnight so what did I expect. I’m honestly appalled, I did not initiate any type of blame when I called, I called to ask questions about his breathing and if I could still bring him in. They continued to tell me he’d be fine so I told them, you are not sitting here looking at his eyes roll around and struggle to breathe, he is NOT fine.

Every place usually has some bad reviews from time to time, and I really wish I listened to the reviews. I was actually recommended to come here from another facility  that was about to close. I’m sure Mid Valley Veterinary deals with angry owners, but rightfully so because they have the rude staff. Sorry, but they do. They made me feel bad for asking questions, huffing and puffing over me asking for different quotes, and brushed off Mochi’s health.
